edits.old: The input is a JSON object. "node_title" contains the existing hierarchy node title. "post" contains the complete original post.
edits.new: The input is a JSON object. "node_title" contains the existing hierarchy node title. "node_description" contains the same saved meaning of that node for every post. "post" contains the complete original post.

edits.old: The hierarchy node title comes from Nostr posts, where hashtags can identify communities. Use the complete post to interpret the hierarchy node title as it is used on Nostr.
edits.new: Use the supplied node_description to determine what concerns the hierarchy node. Assess the complete post against that same node meaning; do not redefine the node according to each post.
